text:
message: I ask you to pray for me, my dear brother
reply: 🙏 According to the desire of God, may there be prayer
reply: 🙇 In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit ❤️✝️🕊️ : May the LORD bless you, your family, your church and your country exceedingly abundantly more than anyone can ask or think Amen! 🙏
